newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Banco de A. Edwards issues bonds.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Banco de A. Edwards issues bonds.

text.p: Chile's Banco de A. Edwards said it has issued $23.8 million subordinated bonds in Santiago's Stock Exchange with the proceeds used to boost the bank's capital base and develop new projects.

The bonds, issued in the inflation-linked currency known as Unidad de Fomento, were placed at an interest rate of 6.726 percent, said the manager of the bank's international and finance division Julio Guzman.
The bonds were bought by pension finds and insurance companies, Guzman told Reuters.
Banco Edwards, Chile's fourth largest private bank, reported profits of 13.8 billion pesos in the first nine months of the year.
